== Title ==
<span lang="ja">間違いない、反乱軍の秘密基地だ！</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">自分の支配フェイズに自分の宇宙船を1隻、通常どおりにフォースを消費して、自分のプローブ・ドロイドがいる位置と同じ星系に移動させる。ただし航行速度で到達できる場合に限る。その宇宙船はそのターンにはもはや移動することはできない。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「この星系だ。間違いなくスカイウォーカーも一緒に居る」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — That's It, The Rebels Are There!.

'''Lore''' — This is the system. Skywalker is certainly with them as well.

'''Game text''' — During your control phase, move one of your starships, spending Force as usual, to the same system as a location where you have a Probe Droid. Only if it can be reached by hyperspeed. That starship can no longer move this turn.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The printed title means “no mistake, it is the Rebel secret base,” not a literal That’s It, The Rebels Are There. Movement is to the system matching the Probe Droid’s 位置, limited by 航行速度, not “if within range.”<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-thatsittherebelsarethere-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[That's It, The Rebels Are There!]].</ref>
